//: Fingerprint registry for fixture classification. Two independent fields, because the two hash types are different computations and the provenance of the second is NOT established.
//rawTextSha256: sha256 over the exact meeting_transcripts.fullText bytes (UTF-8), as computed locally by the toolkit. Reproducible by anyone holding the text.
//storedContentHash: The meeting_transcripts.contentHash column value as stored by the application. Its normalization algorithm and provenance are NOT established by the toolkit; it is recorded by observation only. Do not describe it as provider-versioned.
//matchRule: A record matching either list is labelled a KNOWN FIXTURE by fingerprint. A record matching neither is UNKNOWN - not 'verified real'. Title alone never changes a classification. Excluding fixtures requires --exclude-fixtures.
notes: The rawTextSha256 entry above is a 443-character webhook-setup transcript observed on three separate meeting records (2026-09-22, 2026-10-13 x2). It is short, repetitive test content.
The storedContentHash entry above is the contentHash stored on those same records.

sha256 over whitespace-collapsed text of the same document is a third, distinct value and is deliberately not registered: collapsing whitespace is not a normalization this toolkit applies to source text.
